name: Variations, instructions and claims
one_line: Changes to what was agreed, and the arguments about who pays for them: architect's and employer's instructions, confirmations of verbal instruction, variation orders and their registers, requests for information whose answers change the work, early-warning and delay notices, extension-of-time submissions, loss-and-expense and disruption claims, and the adjudication or dispute bundles those become. Its defining property is that it is ADVERSARIAL and NOTICE-BOUND — a right is lost if a notice is late, so the paperwork exists to be produced later against someone, and it pulls diaries, photographs, programmes and correspondence into purpose-coherent bundles that share no content at all. Absorbs the legacy row cons.variation-claim. Placeholder row researched to J-DEPTH: it recognises the situation and writes NO field rows, because the construction_property schema declares none. The family's landed spine construction_property.construction-project explicitly conceded the numbered instruction to this row when it demoted five of its own eight signals, and the landed construction_property.timesheet REFUSAL routes the signed daywork sheet here as contractual evidence that extra work was done; both dependencies are carried below.

proposed_fields.example: the site or unit a change is instructed at - Plot 4 Kilnfield, Unit 3B Harbour Works
proposed_fields.why_no_existing_key: NOT this row's proposal. A SECOND of the key the construction_property schema row already proposes, recorded so R1c settles it once rather than twenty-seven times, exactly as construction_property.subcontract did. This row's own datum for the adjudication is a weak one and it is stated as weak: a variation is anchored to a CONTRACT far more reliably than to a property, and multi-plot instructions ('all plots, revised soil stack detail') carry several properties or none. That is a reason `property` should not be assumed to be the first dimension everywhere, not a reason against the key.
proposed_fields.destination_eligible_why: Follows the schema proposal unchanged; this row does not reopen it, and records only the caveat above.
proposed_fields.reliability_why: Unchanged from the schema's proposal. An address is this family's constitutional never-alone, and on this row it appears at once as the site, the instructing consultant's letterhead, the employer's registered office and a comparable property cited in a claim narrative. A gazetteer-plus-context rule family would be needed to reach `validated`; R2 owns that rule and this row does not write it.

proposed_fields.example: the contract a change is instructed under - Job 2431 Kilnfield Phase 2
proposed_fields.why_no_existing_key: NOT this row's proposal. A SECOND of the schema row's key, which also records a live alternative (reuse the canonical `project`). This row's datum is the most specific one in the family, and it cuts BOTH ways. In favour of the key: a variation is meaningless without the contract it varies - VO 17 exists on every job on earth - which is 00's own reason for putting a course above a homework number, “a parent dimension should provide the context required to understand the child”. Against relying on it alone: this row needs a container BELOW the instruction, because its defining artefact is one change or one claim assembled from files that share nothing else, and no canonical key and no existing family proposal holds THE CHANGE ITSELF. This row deliberately does NOT mint a key for it - minting a construction-flavoured variant is the defect D6 exists to kill - and instead raises it as an open question for R1c, since if no key holds the change, the recommended second dimension of this row cannot be built from a declared field.
proposed_fields.destination_eligible_why: Proposed TRUE, following the schema row unchanged.
proposed_fields.reliability_why: As the schema proposed. A job or contract reference is a short alphanumeric token and a bare token is the weakest evidence there is; it reaches `direct` only from a labelled slot such as an instruction header's contract field.

proposed_fields.example: the party whose own claim file this is - the contractor, the employer, or the consultant advising one of them
proposed_fields.why_no_existing_key: NOT a new proposal - a SECOND of the key already proposed by business_operations and seconded by construction_property and construction_property.subcontract. Adjudicate once, there, for all of them. This row's datum is the strongest in the family, because this row is the one where custody changes the MEANING and not merely the shelf: a claim submission and a claim response are the same document family with the roles reversed, the letterhead is frequently a consultant's rather than a party's, and the same adjudication bundle exists in both parties' hands. Which side the holder is on is the fact this row most wants and least reliably has.
proposed_fields.destination_eligible_why: Proposed FALSE, following business_operations unchanged - an organisation level inside one firm's corpus is the collector level 00's own template validator rejects. This row does not reopen it, and notes that its own need is a SEARCH and privacy need rather than a folder need, which is consistent with FALSE.
proposed_fields.reliability_why: As business_operations proposed it. A firm name is the multi-role token of “A university name alone should not create a group because Columbia can appear as an authoring school, course provider, target institution, employer, research venue, or merely a cited organization.” read across to a company - and on this row one document routinely names four firms in four roles.

deterministic: PRECONDITION: every entry below is a DETECTION signal and never an extraction licence. The construction_property schema declares no field rows (D1 as narrowed, _CONTRACT rules 10 and 15, CONNECTION PR-6), so nothing here writes a domain fact; detection exists so the material is recognised, kept where this row’s sensitivity says, and offered honestly. “Privacy policy must be enforced before content reaches any model or external connector.”

the instruction structure: a numbered, dated instruction issued by a named contract role — architect, contract administrator, employer's agent, engineer — describing a change to the works, referencing a contract clause that empowers it, and often stating whether it carries a cost or time consequence.

the variation-register structure, this row's fingerprint: a table whose columns read variation number, description, originating instruction or RFI, a quoted or agreed value, a time effect in days, a status (submitted, agreed, disputed, rejected) and a date, with running totals of agreed and disputed sums at the foot. The pairing of a MONEY column with a TIME-EFFECT column beside a DISPUTE STATUS is what no other table in this catalogue has. “Tables matter because resumes, forms, applications, invoices, and administrative documents often place their most useful information in cells rather than body paragraphs.”

a notice structure with a time bar: a dated letter or form referring to a clause, stating an event, and asserting that it is served within a stated number of days of becoming aware — early warning, delay notification, compensation event, or notice of claim. The self-referential timeliness statement is characteristic and appears in almost nothing else.
a request for information and its response: a numbered query about the design, an answer, and a note of whether the answer changes the works — the commonest origin of a variation.

an extension-of-time submission: a narrative of delay events mapped onto a programme, with a critical-path or as-planned-versus-as-built analysis, an entitlement claimed in days, and appendices of diaries, weather records and correspondence.

a loss-and-expense or disruption claim: heads of claim (preliminaries, prolongation, thickening, finance, head office overhead), a quantified build-up per head, and a causal narrative linking each to an event.
a dispute bundle: a paginated, indexed compilation of correspondence, records and submissions produced for adjudication, mediation or arbitration, with a referral or response document at the front.

the DAYWORK SHEET structure, carried here because the landed construction_property.timesheet refusal routed it here and this row must be able to hold it: a dated sheet naming operatives, hours, plant and materials used on one described piece of work, countersigned or initialled by the client's agent, and headed or annotated with an instruction or variation reference. What makes it this row's and not a labour record is the COUNTERSIGNATURE BY THE OTHER SIDE together with the reference to a described extra - it is not a record of who worked, it is evidence tendered to someone who must pay. Without the countersignature and the reference it is a labour allocation sheet and construction_property.site-diary's; that is the discriminator the refusal itself named.

a SCOTT SCHEDULE or claim-and-response matrix: a table with one row per disputed item and columns that are, in order, the claiming party's case, the responding party's case, and a column left blank for a tribunal's or adjudicator's decision. The empty third column reserved for a third party is structurally unlike every other table in this catalogue, all of which are written by one side for its own purposes; a table that anticipates being adjudicated is a fingerprint of nothing else. Provenance: inference - 00 licenses reading cells (“Tables matter because resumes, forms, applications, invoices, and administrative documents often place their most useful information in cells rather than body paragraphs.”) but names no such document.
parent-folder context naming a variation number, a claim, a notice or an adjudication, treated as a clue once one of the structures above is present. Folder context never fires alone.
needs_llm: PRECONDITION: claim material is prepared against a named opponent, frequently reviewed by lawyers, and is among the most commercially damaging material a construction business holds. Any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy. “Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default, should not display raw content in general group summaries, and should not be moved automatically without a user policy that explicitly permits it.”

the central determination for this row: separating a VARIATION (a change the client wants, to be paid for) from a DEFECT (something built wrong, to be put right free). The same item is presented as each by the two sides, in good faith, and both readings are written down.

separating a CONTEMPORANEOUS RECORD from CLAIM MATERIAL made out of it. A diary page, a photograph and a delivery note become exhibits when a claim is built; the bytes do not change and the purpose does. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”
separating which SIDE the holder is on. A claim submission and a claim response are the same document family with the roles reversed, and the letterhead is often a consultant's rather than a party's.

an unlabelled instruction: an email saying 'yes go ahead with the extra sockets' that is legally an instruction and looks like nothing at all — the commonest real variation in small works and the hardest file in this row.

a purpose-coherent claim bundle whose members are individually unremarkable — three diary pages, a weather report, a programme extract, two photographs and a subcontractor's quotation, assembled for one argument. This row is 00's own example shape: “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”

reading a claim bundle through 00's OWN purpose-packet procedure rather than through any mechanism invented here. 00 states the questions to ask of a content-incoherent group directly: “whether the files plausibly serve one shared workflow, whether the group is purpose-coherent despite topic diversity, which members appear to be supporting materials rather than unrelated records, and whether any member conflicts with the proposed purpose”. The last clause is the one this row needs most, because a claim bundle deliberately contains comparator files from OTHER contracts, and those are precisely members that conflict with the proposed purpose. A bundle folder name is evidence of purpose and nothing else: “Purpose may be supported strongly by an existing user-created folder name or explicit language in a form or portal.” and “It is a purpose clue and a review aid, not a basis for automatic semantic propagation.”
in every case above, abstention is the required outcome where the evidence does not settle it. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”
never_alone: a numbered reference alone. VO 17, AI 44, RFI 231, EW 06 — every construction row numbers its documents, and the prefixes are not standardised across contracts, firms or countries.

the word 'variation', “instruction”, “claim” or “notice” alone. An insurance claim, a warranty claim, a legal notice, a payment notice and a work instruction in manufacturing are five different rows in this roster that all match.

a UK-style postcode or a street address alone. An address is the single most tempting token in this whole family and it appears in every role at once — the site, the client’s home, the contractor’s registered office, the architect’s letterhead, a supplier’s depot, and a comparable property cited in a report. 00 states the same ambiguity for a university name: “A university name alone should not create a group because Columbia can appear as an authoring school, course provider, target institution, employer, research venue, or merely a cited organization.” — the address case is worse, and this is recorded as inference because 00 writes that sentence about a university, not an address.
a currency figure alone. This row is dense in them and so is every quote, valuation, invoice and account in the family.

a clause reference alone. It looks like a section number, a drawing reference, a standard reference or a version number, and only the surrounding sentence says which. This is 00's bare-number problem in a different costume.
a contract role name alone (architect, contract administrator, engineer). It appears as an author, an addressee, a copied party and a template's default heading.

source_type or extension alone. “treat the file extension as a routing signal rather than an assumption about meaning”, and file_kind_plausible is constitutionally never-alone (CONNECTION section 5, invariant 2).
membership in a download session — a whole project folder or a document-portal export pulled down at once. “A session should never be treated as proof of topic”
a bare 4-digit number read as a year. It is at least as often a drawing number, a job number, a plot number, a house number, a cost code, or a British Standard reference.

a PDF author, producer, or company metadata string alone. “PDF metadata should be treated as supporting evidence, not as truth” — one contractor’s template stamps the same firm on every blank form it ever generated.

a STATUS column alone (submitted, agreed, disputed, rejected, open, closed). It is the most generic vocabulary in the catalogue and it is the same column that appears on a snagging list, an issue log, an RFI tracker, a risk register and a support queue. This row's fingerprint is the status column standing BESIDE both a money column and a time-effect column; no one of the three earns anything on its own. Added this pass because the gist row named the triple as a fingerprint without disqualifying its parts, and a fingerprint whose parts are not disqualified is an assertion.

citation in a bundle index, or membership of a folder named for a claim or an adjudication. This is the trap this row is likeliest to spring, because its defining artefact is an assembly of OTHER rows' files: a diary page cited as an appendix stays construction_property.site-diary's record, a photograph stays construction_property.progress-photos', a delivery note stays construction_property.materials-delivery's. Purpose may be read from the folder; ownership may not. “The graph does not automatically copy those missing facts onto sparse files.”

a countersignature alone. A signature from the other side appears on a delivery note, a snagging sign-off, an induction register, a handover acceptance and a payment certificate. It is half of the daywork discriminator and never the whole of it.

work_types: variation quotation or price for a change
signed daywork sheet (ROUTED HERE by the construction_property.timesheet refusal - a work_type value of this row, never a row of its own)
delay analysis or programme impact assessment
grouping_reasons: one variation from origin to settlement: the RFI or instruction that started it, the quotation, the register entry, the agreement or rejection and the sum that reached the account.

one claim: the notice, the submission, the appendices, the response and the outcome — the strongest purpose-coherent group in the whole construction family, because 00's own sentence describes it exactly: “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”
one contract's whole change history, which is what the final account is built from.
one submission across its drafts, joined by the universal version_family fact rather than by any construction fact.
no group at all is a valid outcome: an isolated instruction with no reference is an ordinary standalone record.

and the mechanism for that group is 00's own, not one invented here: the purpose packet. “Purpose must be a first-class facet.” The LLM is asked “whether the files plausibly serve one shared workflow, whether the group is purpose-coherent despite topic diversity, which members appear to be supporting materials rather than unrelated records, and whether any member conflicts with the proposed purpose” - and a bundle folder name is evidence of the purpose only: “A tight download session alone is never sufficient: it is a retrieval clue that may bring the files together, but not proof of their shared purpose.”

and the stop rules apply as written — “when members carry irreconcilable course, institution, project, term, or purpose facts” — and this row makes the reason vivid: a claim bundle deliberately contains files from other projects as comparators, and they must not be absorbed.

template.why: Empty by binding contract: a dimension may only branch on a field the same entry’s schema declares, and construction_property declares none (D1 as narrowed, _CONTRACT rules 10 and 15, CONNECTION PR-6). That is a contract fact, not a claim that this situation has no shape — it plainly does, and it is recorded here as PROSE for whoever answers the schema row’s open_question. The recommendation, held as prose: the project or contract first, then the change or claim itself as its own container (the variation number, or the named claim), then the document function inside it — origin, quotation, notice, submission, response, outcome. The change must be its own level rather than a document-type shelf, because this row's defining artefact is a BUNDLE of otherwise unrelated files held together by one argument, and a type-first tree would scatter exactly the files that must stay together. A variation number is meaningless without its contract — VO 17 exists on every job — which is 00's own reason for putting a course above a homework number. 00’s own ordering reason applies: “a parent dimension should provide the context required to understand the child”. Not time-first — “For document and record domains, project, function, or subject usually comes before time because putting year first scatters related work across calendar folders.” And whatever eventually lands stays a recommendation: “The system recommends an order based on the domain template, but the user can reverse, remove, add, or flatten dimensions.”

collides_with.signal: The load-bearing collision on this row, stated reciprocally in the same words on both. The same item is a paid VARIATION on one side's paper and a free DEFECT on the other's. The discriminating evidence: a numbered instruction reference, a quantified cost and time consequence, and an approval or notice support this row; a location, a responsible trade, a status column and a re-inspection history support the snagging row. Where both are present the file is genuinely both, and abstention is the correct outcome. Provenance: inference.

A change order to a scope of supply has this row's exact structure — numbered, priced, time-affecting, approved. The discriminating evidence: a machine, a line, a part number or a specification revision supports the engineering row; a site, a contract clause and a construction instruction role support this row. Provenance: inference.

Agreed variations become account line items and the boundary is agreement itself. The discriminating evidence: a valuation number, a certified sum, retention and a settlement statement support the final-account row; a disputed or unagreed change, a notice and a claim narrative support this row. Provenance: inference.

Diaries and confirmations of verbal instruction are simultaneously the diary's serial record and this row's opening evidence, and a claim bundle is largely made of diary pages. The discriminating evidence: a numbered claim or variation reference and a quantified consequence support this row; an unaddressed daily entry in an unbroken run supports the diary. Citation in a bundle index never transfers ownership. Provenance: inference.

The same change cascades down as a subcontract variation and the same claim is made upward and defended downward, on near-identical paper. The discriminating evidence: a subcontract order reference, a payment application or a statutory payment notice supports the subcontract row; a main-contract instruction and a claim against the employer support this row. Provenance: inference.

An adjudication bundle is simultaneously this row's compilation and a practitioner's exhibit set. The discriminating evidence: a matter reference, a paginated exhibit convention and a solicitor's framing support the practitioner row; a party's own claim file supports this row. Because legal is a safety schema, where both fire the protective ordering runs first. Provenance: inference.

Reciprocal with the landed row, which already names construction_property.subcontract for the same reason. Variations, notices and obligation tracking are the general commercial shape of this row. The discriminating evidence: a site, a works package, a programme impact and a statutory construction notice regime support this row; a general contract register and a renewal calendar support the business row. Provenance: inference.

A disruption claim against an employer and an insurance claim for the same event are argued from the same photographs and the same diary pages. The discriminating evidence: a policy number, an insurer, a loss adjuster and a claim reference support the insurance row; a contract clause, an entitlement in days and a head-of-claim build-up support this row. Because finance is a safety schema, where both fire the protective ordering runs first. Provenance: inference.

Reciprocal, and the landed spine states this side FIRST; its wording is adopted rather than re-authored, because it conceded the point when it demoted five of its own eight signals. In its own words: “The instruction is intelligible only above the job, and that tempts this row to claim it. It must not. The discriminating evidence: a numbered instruction, a confirmation of verbal instruction, an extension-of-time or loss-and-expense submission and the dispute bundle they become support the sibling; the contract they vary supports this row.” This row accepts the concession and states the limit of what it settles: a concession decides WHICH of two rows owns a structure, not that the structure earns a row - that is argued in the memo on this row's own merits. Shared fixture named identically on both sides: AI 014 - relocate soil stack.pdf. Belonging to a job folder is browse, not activation (CONNECTION.md §3). Provenance: inference.

A VARIATION QUOTATION is a priced schedule of works with quantities, rates, a validity period and an acceptance line - the sibling's structure exactly. The discriminating evidence, taken from that row's own stated anchor rather than invented here: its anchor is a PROSPECT, an address and an enquiry at a moment when there is no job, no contract and no job number to file the price under; this row's price sits INSIDE a live contract, under an instruction or variation number, and is an adjustment to an agreed sum rather than an offer to form one. The sibling also lists 'acceptance or instruction to proceed' in its own work_types, which is the sharpest overlap: an instruction to proceed on a NEW enquiry is its acceptance event, and an instruction to proceed on EXTRA work inside a running contract is this row's variation. That row has not yet stated this seam; the reciprocal is owed and is flagged in the memo. Shared fixture: Quotation for VO 17 - revised drainage.pdf. Provenance: inference.

Reciprocal, and the sibling states this side already; its wording is adopted unchanged: “Shortage and damage records become the substantiation of a claim. The discriminating evidence: an assertion of entitlement with a narrative and a cost consequence supports the claim row; the contemporaneous record of what arrived supports this row.” This row adds only the direction that matters to it: a delivery note cited in a claim appendix is still that row's record. Provenance: inference.

The sibling's memo states this seam and its wording is adopted: “a numbered instruction, a confirmation of verbal instruction, or the change submission built on it” is this row's; “the revised sheet issued *because of* an instruction — that is an issue, and it is on the register” is the sibling's. The sketch attached to an architect's instruction is the shared bytes: it travels with the instruction and it is also a drawing issue, and neither row may take it on the other's evidence. The sibling carries this in its memo but not yet as a JSON edge; this entry is authored from this side and the reciprocal JSON entry is owed to R1c. Provenance: inference.

An EARLY-WARNING or compensation-event notice is a risk entry with a contract clause on it, and the two documents can be the same sentence twice. The discriminating evidence: an internal register an organisation keeps for its own management, with owners, likelihood and mitigation columns and no addressee, supports the business row; a notice ADDRESSED AND DATED FOR SERVICE on a counterparty under a named clause, whose lateness forfeits a right, supports this row. The time bar is the whole discriminator: a risk register is prudent, a notice is a condition precedent. Shared fixture: Early warning 06 - crane oversail licence.pdf. Provenance: inference.

Without-prejudice offers, walk-away positions and settlement agreements exist identically as a party's own claim file and as a practitioner's settlement workstream. The discriminating evidence: a matter reference, an engagement, a client identified as someone other than the holder and a practitioner's file convention support the law_practice row; a party's own commercial position on its own contract supports this row. Because legal is a safety schema, where both fire the protective ordering runs first and the legal reading protects before this one organises. Shared fixture: WP - settlement proposal.docx. This complements rather than duplicates the existing law_practice.evidence-exhibits edge: that one is about the BUNDLE, this one about the OFFER. Provenance: inference.

also_holds_with.why: A claim, a notice under a clause and an adjudication referral are legal material as well as construction records, and legal is a safety domain: “Finance, identity, medical, and legal material should be implemented first as safety domains”. Co-activation is correct and PROTECTIVE ORDERING APPLIES - the legal reading protects first and this row's organising reading is additive. “One file may hold facts from more than one domain without losing information.” The gist row expressed this only as also_schema on two fixtures and noted that also_holds_with joins schemas; the landed spine carries schema-level entries on a template-kind row, so this row follows the family rather than diverging. Provenance: inference.

An agreed variation sum and a settlement figure are genuinely finance records for whoever's books they land in, and genuinely this situation's. Neither reading displaces the other, and finance being a safety domain means its posture is not weakened by this row's. Provenance: inference.

A contractor's claim file is simultaneously an entry in the firm's own contract-administration record, which is why business_operations.contract-administration is carried as a collision at row level. Both readings are true of the same bytes at schema level and neither is a collision there. Provenance: inference.

falls_through_to.why: The primary home for the row's most damaging members — without-prejudice correspondence, settlement positions, claim submissions and adjudication material. This row is prepared against an opponent, and exposure has consequences that no other construction row's does. “Protected Records may represent sensitive isolated material such as passport scans, medical documents, account statements, visas, legal forms, or credentials; it should normally remain local-only and must not cause filenames or content to be exposed in model prompts.”

The home for a standalone instruction or notice arriving with no contract file around it — a durable record with no group. “Independent Records may live under Personal/Independent Records and hold standalone certificates, notices, confirmations, forms, and PDFs that have a durable purpose but no broader group.”

The honest outcome for a variation register, an unlabelled go-ahead email, or a bundle whose contract and side are unresolved. “Review Later may hold files whose meaning is partly understood but whose final location requires a future decision.”

Password-protected dispute bundles and legal-platform exports are ordinary here and arrive routinely. “Unsupported or Encrypted may hold—or, more safely, represent without moving—password-protected archives, unreadable documents, damaged files, and unknown formats.”

Standard-form notice templates, published contract guidance and precedent claim structures are reference material, not records. “Reference Clips may live under Personal/Reference Clips and hold saved visual inspiration, product references, quotes, recipes, short article captures, code snippets, or other material that is useful for later retrieval but does not belong to a current project.”

Contract commentaries, adjudication case summaries and published guidance on time bars are reading material rather than claim files. “Reading Inbox may hold papers, articles, reports, and saved PDFs that appear to be reading material but have no active research, course, or project association.”

sensitivity_why: This row is prepared for a fight. Its files state a party's own weaknesses, its walk-away figure, its internal assessment of an opponent, and its legal advice; a without-prejudice settlement note is the single most damaging document a construction business can leak. 00's corpus sentence covers the category — the corpus “can include identity documents, account statements, tax records, medical information, legal records, credentials, private correspondence, GPS metadata, employment materials, and educational records” — and legal records are named in it directly. Beyond that, and as inference rather than a design claim, the exposure risk here is asymmetric in a way most rows' is not: the harm is not embarrassment but the loss of the claim itself. This row assigns only the catalogue value potentially_sensitive; the handling class is P7's and is not set here.
open_question: Three. (1) The defect-or-variation boundary, stated reciprocally with construction_property.snagging-defects in the same words on both rows: often undecidable, because both sides write their reading down in good faith. The correct behaviour is to recognise both and abstain — “conflicting signals should lead to abstention rather than an invented classification”, reinforced by 00's acceptance rule, which requires that “the best legal destination must reach a minimum support threshold and must exceed the next-best destination by a meaningful margin”, and by “Conflicting evidence should actively suppress nodes.” Whether a genuinely-both file is offered in two places or held in one is Joseph's. (2) The bundle problem, NARROWED THIS PASS rather than restated. The gist row said this row asserts no mechanism beyond the firewall. That was too pessimistic: 00 does supply a mechanism, the purpose packet, and it already contains the exact clause this row needs — “whether any member conflicts with the proposed purpose” — which is what disposes of the comparator files a bundle deliberately imports from OTHER contracts. What remains genuinely open is narrower and worth a decision before P9 builds grouping: whether a bundle FOLDER, scanned as a folder, is read as a purpose clue only (as 00's sentences require) or is allowed to become a group root, and whether an index file's citations may be used as retrieval at all. (3) NEW: no key holds THE CHANGE. This row's recommended second dimension is the individual variation or claim, and neither the canonical fields nor any of the family's three proposals name it. This row refuses to mint one. If R1c does not resolve it, this row's recommended tree cannot be built from declared fields even after D1's deferral lifts, and it would collapse to the schema default plus a document-function shelf — which is the shape this row argues is wrong for it.
